funding.name: Florida Law Enforcement Recruitment Bonus Payment Program
funding.provides: The program pays a one-time bonus to each eligible newly employed law enforcement officer in the state.
funding.eligibility: Person who gains or is appointed to full-time employment as a certified law enforcement officer with a Florida agency; the agency determines eligible employees with FloridaCommerce

funding.name: Florida Job Growth Grant Fund
funding.provides: The Florida Job Growth Grant Fund supports workforce or infrastructure needs in communities, with proposals reviewed by FloridaCommerce and chosen by the Governor.
funding.how_to_apply: Submit a proposal for review by FloridaCommerce

funding.name: Shipbuilding and Defense Industrial Base Apprenticeship Incentive Fund
funding.provides: The fund supports sponsors of Registered Apprenticeship programs in shipbuilding, maritime, defense, aerospace, advanced manufacturing and related industries, for approved occupations such as welders, electricians and aircraft mechanics.
funding.eligibility: Sponsors (employers, industry organizations or other entities) running Registered Apprenticeship programs in qualifying industries and approved occupations
funding.how_to_apply: Submit an application through the online portal

funding.name: Florida Military Family Employment Advocacy Program
funding.provides: The Military Family Employment Advocacy Program connects military spouses, dependents and activated Florida National Guard members with employment advocates.
funding.eligibility: Military spouses and dependents, active duty military personnel and activated Florida National Guard members (per program overview)
funding.how_to_apply: Contact a Florida Employment Advocate listed on the program page
